lines: Round 7 is the last round of the look lock. Its build is frozen and four render agents are making the gate and the packs; their reports are due about 23:00 UTC
While they render I have prepared Phase 4 without starting it: each of the three seasons split into one file per part; ten job messages and the common brief written; a sound job written
Next: the gate and the measures of Round 7 then its critics and jurors; then the look lock is closed whatever they say and the three seasons start in parallel
phase 3: 14.26 h used of its 11.00 h box
allowance (before the review): 20.87 h used of 36.00 h allowed
